subject: Web Development
title: Caching: The Browser's Memory
description: One-minute skill: Caching: The Browser's Memory.

hook.text: Visit a site today and it loads slowly. Visit tomorrow and it's instant. That's caching.

buildup.text: Browsers store downloaded files locally so they don't fetch the same resource twice.

discovery.text: HTTP headers like Cache-Control tell the browser exactly how long to keep each file.

twist.text: Stale caches cause bugs. Users see old code while developers wonder why their fix isn't working.

climax.text: Cache busting with versioned filenames solves this, but adds complexity to every deploy.

quiz.question: What tells the browser how long to cache a file?
